description: This file defines classes and macros for warning reporting and control within a software system, including categories, bounds, and warning event handling.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Manages lists of callsigns and modules excluded from warning reports.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton proxy class for handling warning reporting events and category information.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing bounds and analysis for specific warning categories.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category with analysis, serialization, and control features.

classes.name: WarningReportingControl
classes.description: Nested class within WarningReportingType managing category control, configuration, and exclusion.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures bounds or category settings based on provided string.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes whether a warning should be reported based on actual value and category bounds.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts category data to string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current category state is a warning.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks or sets whether the category is enabled.
